title: CAD IR Phase 9 — External part references + BOM compiler
summary: Specifies extending PartRef into an inline|external discriminated union, AABB interference handling for externals, and a recursive BOM compiler aggregating externals by vendor+partNumber.
notes: Hybrid: structured as a step-by-step implementation plan (DOC-flavored) but the load-bearing content is technical contracts (PartRef union types, Zod schema, BomEntry interface, compileBom signature, add_part tool schema). Resolved as SPEC via ambiguity rule (SPEC > DOC). No frontmatter; not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences); not a PRD (no user stories or business goals).
